In a message issued on Friday to mark the Iranian Army Navy Day, observed on November 28, Abdollahi highlighted the force’s key role in safeguarding Iran’s national security and interests.
​
He said the Army Navy, in coordination with the Islamic Revolution Guards Corps (IRGC) Navy, maintains combat and operational readiness to protect Iran’s territorial waters and uphold the country’s authority in the Sea of Oman.
​
Abdollahi added that the force stands ready to respond to any threat or aggression in accordance with the directives of the Leader of the Islamic Revolution, the commander-in-chief of the Armed Forces.
